summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (P18) proposing an assay to test whether SS-31 (elamipretide) retains cardiolipin-pathway mitochondrial phenotype under a matched ROS-scavenger condition that abolishes antioxidant-class OCR rescue. The document is a hypothesis/discussion card at TRL 1–2, framing a pre-registered experimental design to distinguish cardiolipin-specific from generic antioxidant mechanisms of SS-31. No experimental data have been generated; all supporting evidence is from published literature (Birk, Chatfield, Chavez), and the key matched residual H2H experiment is explicitly UNKNOWN/NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement
content_blocks.content: P18 claims: On a matched insult ± SS-31 ± MitoTEMPO (or other mito ROS-scavenger) cell/mito panel with scavenger-alone OCR-abolish QC plus OCR / ETC-coupling / supercomplex readouts, under a matched ROS-scavenger that abolishes antioxidant-class OCR rescue, residual SS-31 cardiolipin-path OCR (or ETC-coupling / supercomplex) remains ≥50% of the SS-31 without-matched-scavenger arm on the same panel. This is framed as an 'assumption-kill' / cardiolipin-insufficiency test. The named comparator is the SS-31 without-matched-scavenger arm under matched insult.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Why It Matters
content_blocks.content: Birk/Szeto frame SS-31 as a cardiolipin binder that protects cytochrome c electron-carrier function and re-energizes ischemic mitochondria. Chatfield shows elamipretide improves OCR/supercomplex in failing human heart explants. Chavez maps an SS-31–cardiolipin protein interactome. P18 asks whether residual cardiolipin-path mito phenotype under a matched ROS-scavenger that abolishes antioxidant-class OCR rescue still requires the cardiolipin path rather than generic antioxidant attribution — framed as a cardiolipin-insufficiency assumption-kill. Distinct from P15 (BPC residual-FBXO22), P16 (LKKTETQ-Cc), and P17 (MOTS-c/folate).

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Cardiolipin-insufficiency assumption-kill: Birk shows SS-31 binds cardiolipin on IMM, inhibits cyt-c peroxidase, and re-energizes ischemic mitochondria / promotes ETC via cardiolipin–cyt c (LITERATURE). Chatfield improves failing-heart OCR/supercomplex (LITERATURE). Chavez interactome supports cardiolipin binders (LITERATURE). None of these score residual SS-31 under a ROS-scavenger condition that abolishes antioxidant-class OCR rescue on the same panel. Marketed antioxidant framing and adjacent MitoQ-vs-SS-31 comparative / MitoTEMPO tool co-use are the assumption under kill — parallel arms ≠ matched residual H2H.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
1. PMID 23813215 (Birk 2013 JASN): SS-31 binds cardiolipin on IMM; SS-31/cardiolipin inhibits cytochrome c peroxidase; re-energizes ischemic mitochondria / accelerates ATP recovery — cardiolipin-path / ischemic re-energization prior; NOT residual-under-scavenger H2H.
2. PMID 24134698 (Birk 2014 Br J Pharmacol): SS-31 selectively binds cardiolipin; protects electron-carrier function of cyt c; promotes ETC / optimizes mitochondrial ATP synthesis via cardiolipin–cyt c — ETC-coupling prior; NOT residual-under-scavenger H2H.
3. PMID 31061916 (Chatfield 2019 JACC Basic Transl Sci): elamipretide improves mitochondrial oxygen flux, CI/CIV activities, and supercomplex-associated CIV in freshly explanted failing human heart tissue — failing-heart OCR/supercomplex prior; NOT residual under matched MitoTEMPO/ROS-scavenger that abolishes antioxidant-class OCR.
4. PMID 32554501 (Chavez 2020 PNAS): SS-31 protein interaction landscape via XL-MS; interactors are known cardiolipin binders (OXPHOS / 2-oxoglutarate metabolism) — interactome prior supporting cardiolipin-path; NOT residual-under-scavenger H2H.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay / Method Design
content_blocks.content: Method: propose-assay. Design: matched insult ± SS-31 ± MitoTEMPO (or other mito ROS-scavenger) cell/mito panel. Required QC: scavenger-alone OCR-abolish gate must be passed first. Readouts: OCR, ETC-coupling, supercomplex (optional: cyt-c peroxidase, cardiolipin competition). Named comparator: SS-31 without-matched-scavenger arm under matched insult. Threshold: residual SS-31 cardiolipin-path OCR ≥50% of SS-31 without-matched-scavenger arm. Preference: cell/mito before explant/animal/human. No dosing values specified. α/N to be pre-specified.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat P1–P17 as proving P18 — Birk/Chatfield/Chavez cardiolipin/OCR/interactome priors are not a residual-under-matched-ROS-scavenger H2H; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated residual phenotype.
2. Skip-list / series distinctness (critical) — do not freeze or collapse to OpenLabs 8e5ba06c / 7db12286 BPC orthosteric dialect, P15 residual-FBXO22, P16 LKKTETQ-Cc, or P17 MOTS-c/folate; orthosteric_drift=false; REJECT if claim drifts to BPC/FBXO22/VEGFR2 or LKKTETQ/Tβ4 sequestration or MOTS-c/folate; NOT FOXO4×LOF (SERIES_FROZEN).
3. Birk/Chatfield/Chavez lack matched ROS-scavenger arm that abolishes antioxidant-class OCR; incomplete scavenger match / scavenger-alone OCR not abolished / no residual to score / ROS-match QC failure leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted; no dosing; review 25188726 ≠ experimental anchor.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered matched insult ± SS-31 ± MitoTEMPO (or other mito ROS-scavenger) cell/mito panel where matched scavenger abolishes scavenger-alone antioxidant-class OCR rescue, residual SS-31 cardiolipin-path OCR (or ETC-coupling / supercomplex) is <50% of the SS-31 without-matched-scavenger arm under that same condition — so antioxidant-class framing survives and cardiolipin-insufficiency residual fails — when incomplete scavenger match, scavenger-alone OCR-not-abolished, absent residual, or ROS-match QC artifacts are ruled out.

content_blocks.title: Ablation Analysis
content_blocks.content:
Three critical ablations identified:
1. Remove matched insult ± SS-31 ± MitoTEMPO cell/mito panel under scavenger-abolish condition: Without the scavenger-match × residual H2H, separate Birk/Chatfield/Chavez LITERATURE cannot show cardiolipin-insufficiency of residual SS-31 mito phenotype.
2. Remove scavenger-alone OCR-abolish gate plus SS-31 without-matched-scavenger arm as named residual comparator: Without the OCR-abolish gate and named comparator, the card collapses into Birk/Chatfield phenotype prior or generic antioxidant framing.
3. Remove P15≠P18 + P16≠P18 + P17≠P18 + P1–P17≠proof + soft-complete-empty≠novelty + skip-list-distinct + NOT-FOXO4×LOF discipline: Treating prior series as already deciding residual-under-scavenger would invent an H2H result left UNKNOWN.

The core scientific question is whether SS-31 (elamipretide) retains cardiolipin-pathway mitochondrial phenotype (OCR, ETC-coupling, supercomplex) under a matched ROS-scavenger (e.g., MitoTEMPO) that abolishes antioxidant-class OCR rescue.

All supporting evidence is from published literature: Birk 2013 (PMID 23813215) — SS-31 binds cardiolipin on IMM, inhibits cyt-c peroxidase, re-energizes ischemic mitochondria; Birk 2014 (PMID 24134698) — SS-31 protects cyt c electron-carrier function, promotes ETC; Chatfield 2019 (PMID 31061916) — elamipretide improves OCR/supercomplex in failing human heart explants; Chavez 2020 (PMID 32554501) — SS-31 interactors are known cardiolipin binders (OXPHOS/2-oxoglutarate metabolism).
The key matched residual H2H experiment (SS-31 ± MitoTEMPO under scavenger-abolish QC) is explicitly UNKNOWN — not found in literature search (soft-complete Q1 NON-MATCH / matched residual Q2=0).
Proposed threshold: residual SS-31 cardiolipin-path OCR ≥50% of SS-31 without-matched-scavenger arm under matched insult.
Refutation criterion: residual SS-31 OCR <50% of SS-31 without-matched-scavenger arm when QC artifacts are ruled out.
Competing inconclusive outcomes pre-registered: incomplete scavenger match, scavenger-alone OCR not abolished, absent residual to score, or ROS-match QC failure.
FTO status is UNKNOWN; IP class is cardiolipin-insufficiency; kill cost tier = 1; estimated time to refute = 4 weeks.
Document is labeled NEGATIVE polarity (assumption-kill) and is a research discussion, not a completed experiment.
Series distinctness enforced: P18 is explicitly NOT P15 (BPC/FBXO22), NOT P16 (LKKTETQ-Cc), NOT P17 (MOTS-c/folate), NOT FOXO4×LOF.
